subject: SIG evidence: admin activity export & retention confirmation
messages:
From: sig-audits@acme.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire - audit log evidence request

Hi Soojin,

As part of our SIG review and procurement sign-off we need a timeboxed extract of admin-level activity for the last 90 days. Specifically:
- All console/admin actions (user create/delete, permission changes, role assignments) with ISO timestamps and actor id
- API keys and token lifecycle events (create, revoke) metadata (no secrets)
- Retention policy for admin logs and any automated archival/backup processes
- Preferred export format: CSV or NDJSON, with a README describing fields and UTC timezone

Can you confirm what Redwood can provide and a delivery ETA? The procurement team would like the export delivered to a shared drive or S3 pre-signed URL.

Thanks,
Alicia Chen
Acme Security (SIG)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: sig-audits@acme.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-18T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log evidence request

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for the clear ask — we can provide the requested admin activity extract and a short README. Quick summary up-front:
- What we will deliver: CSV export of admin activity events (create/update/delete) + separate CSV for API key lifecycle events
- Time window: past 90 days (will provide exact first/last timestamps in README)
- Retention: admin activity logs are retained hot for 180 days, then archived to immutable object storage for 3 years (searchable by export process)
- Export mechanics: we will generate NDJSON/CSV and stage a download on a shared Drive link (or S3 pre-signed URL if you prefer).
- ETA: initial export + README by 2026-11-20 10:00 PT (we can accelerate to EOD tomorrow if this is time-sensitive)

Attaching a short runbook for the export process and the intended filename scheme. Will loop in Marissa for data-handling sign-off and Karthik for retention/legal confirmation.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: export-README.txt (describes fields & timestamps)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log evidence request

Team — quick operational notes before we export:
- The admin activity extractor uses the index labeled admin-events-v2; it includes: actor_id, actor_type (user/service), action, target_resource, ip, user_agent, timestamp_utc, request_id, change_summary
- API key lifecycle events are in a separate table (api-keys-events) and include key_id, owner_id, event (create/revoke/rotate), timestamp_utc, initiator_id
- Redaction: we never export secrets or token values. We only include identifiers.
- Export size estimate for 90 days: ~12k rows (admin events) + 1.2k rows (api keys) -> CSVs ~3.4MB compressed
- Hashing/validation: will include SHA256 checksum for each file in the README

I will run the job in a staging project first at 2026-11-19T13:00 PT and then mirror to production export at 2026-11-20T02:00 PT. Flagging to Karthik if anything from a retention or legal perspective needs additional wording in README.

-M

[quoted original]
> From: sig-audits@acme.com
> As part of our SIG review and procurement sign-off we need a timeboxed extract of admin-level activity for the last 90 days...
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log evidence request

Thanks Marissa — confirming retention language for README: 
- Hot retention (searchable): 180 days
- Cold archive (immutable): 3 years (WORM on object store)
- Access controls: exports are generated into a dedicated, access-controlled bucket/drive folder with ACLs restricted to Trust, Legal, and named contacts at the requesting org for 14 days
- Audit trail: every export operation itself logs who initiated, timestamp, job id, and target storage location — we will include that meta-record as part of the deliverable (small JSON manifest).

Two quick asks for Soojin/Marissa: please ensure the export manifest includes job_id and the SHA256 checksums. Also confirm whether Acme prefers drive link or pre-signed S3.

-Karthik
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: sig-audits@acme.com
Cc: procurement@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T10:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - audit log evidence request

Hi Alicia — export complete and uploaded. Delivery details below and small notes about contents.

Files delivered (attached + shared link):
- admin_activity_2026-11-17.csv (CSV, 2.8MB)
- api_key_events_2026-11-17.csv (CSV, 400KB)
- export-manifest-20261120.json (contains job_id: export-7c9f, produced_at UTC, SHA256 filenames)
- export-README.txt (field descriptions, retention language, export process)

Shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.internal/shared/Acme/SIG/admin_activity_2026-11-17.csv (expires: 2026-12-04)
Alternative S3 pre-signed URL available on request.

Notes:
- Timestamps are in UTC in the timestamp_utc column.
- No secrets or token material included; identifier-only fields only.
- Export manifest contains audit record of the export job (operator_id: marissa_cole, job_id: export-7c9f).
- Retention summary is included in README and matches the retention policy previously stated (hot:180d; archive:3y).

If you confirm receipt and that files look good we will mark the request closed. Happy to provide additional slices (e.g., per-region filters) if you need them for SIG questions.

Best,
Soojin
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_2026-11-17.csv, api_key_events_2026-11-17.csv, export-manifest-20261120.json, export-README.txt
